Garage description
When the temperatures start soaring, the Frost paint comes to the rescue with a cool look. Also works great for keeping your soda perfectly chilled.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
The paint first appeared on December 29, 2014, as a special paint for the New Year then it was removed from the store and tank garages on January 12, 2015.
Returned on sale July 21, 2016.
The paint used to only be possible to be purchased with an active premium account.
It was proposed to rent the paint, that is, to receive for the period of the New Year campaign "Elite Tank for the Holidays".
The paint used to have a protection of 20% from all turrets and mines.
Along with the frost paint, it was possible to rent the unique XT Hornet and XT Railgun (in versions from M0 to M3).
The rental price of paint decreased as the end of the offer approached:
December 29 - December 31, 2014 - 200,000
1/01/15 - 132,000
1/02/15 - 86,000

Frost is currently one of only two Epic Garage paints, it's slightly-more-expensive counterpart being Golden Star.
